Name: Mangjiu's Ghostcat
Author: woyaoxiamods
Description:
新档可以在初始界面选择，老档可以去玛妮的商店领养，猫斯特不会直接替换你已拥有的宠物。 
mod作者为乙代梦一体机，默认下载的宝宝们也都是同属性，啾咪。
之后可能会画其他大兵的，但是请勿许愿，谢谢。
英语部分为机翻(￣▽￣)"
New pets can be selected on the initial screen, while old pets can be adopted from Marnie's shop. Chesters will not directly replace pets you already own.  
The mod author is someone who only loves and accepts pairings between characters and readers, and by default, the downloaders also share the same preferences. Love you all.
I might draw other soldiers later, but please refrain from making requests or urging me. Thank you.
